description: Save a durable memory (decision/rule/fact/preference/reference/identity): only what would change what someone does on a DIFFERENT task. Unsanctioned in THIS conversation, it is a PROPOSAL — never present it as a decision. 'identity' is WHO someone is: the user's circle goes in their personal project, a business's people in that business's project. A sourced fact or reference that only informs can be a finding, which cannot replace a sanctioned memory.

backfilled.description: true for sourced HISTORY from before Arroway, on the topic just worked on; never a dump.

content.description: The norm ITSELF, as if true today, in the shortest form that still governs correctly. Biography (who, when, quotes, dated numbers) goes in why_source; a specific case in example.

contradiction.description: Required with supersedes_id: what this changes in the earlier memory.

decided_by_human.description: true ONLY if the person stated or sanctioned it in THIS conversation; else a proposal. A proposal is never free: it costs that person a review. Then only a PINNED memory travels in every read; a normal one competes for space in the block relevant to each task. Never write an instruction to check, verify, be careful or look at the source, a step of a routine, or anything here only because something went wrong once.

essence.description: The operative norm or fact in ONE line.

example.description: A case illustrating the rule, shown in the panel; it NEVER travels in reads, so any criterion goes in content.

example_considered.description: Second call only: true if the flagged example is criterion the rule needs.

expires.description: true ONLY for a dated STATUS that would be stale after review_at. If unsure, omit.

kill_condition.description: Mandatory: explicit revocation / named trigger / review date

pin_decision_token.description: Second call only: the first call's token, unchanged.

pin_requested_by_human.description: true ONLY if the person told you in THIS conversation to keep it in every session. Sanctioning the CONTENT is not asking for the pin. Pins above any ceiling.

pin_suggested.description: Your judgement on pinning (travels in EVERY read). There is no default: required on a rule's second call. Above the ceiling it becomes a proposal of the pin alone.

project.description: Project slug. Not from the person or a read this session? It is a guess: check the arroway_catch_up roster.

related_check_token.description: Second call only: token returned with the related memories.

related_checked.description: Second call only: true after reading the related memories shown.

review_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD when this stops being true on its own. REQUIRED for a fact, which leaves reads after it.

revoked_reconsideration.description: Second call only: the person's words in THIS conversation reconsidering a revoked finding.

source_ptr.description: Pointer to the living source, when verifiable

split_considered.description: true only after looking for seams; splitting is the default.

supersedes_id.description: #handle of the memory this replaces, only for the SAME point: acting on either would already satisfy or violate the other. A shared topic is not enough.

treatment.description: `governed` enters the person's review queue, a real cost to them; `finding` costs nobody a review and is never a norm. Does it GOVERN what someone may or must do, or only INFORM? Informs, with a source an agent can reopen and compare: finding (only fact and reference qualify).

treatment_justification.description: Required for a finding: why it is verifiable context, not policy.

why_source.description: Where it came from: the ONLY place for biography. This does NOT travel in reads; it is shown in the panel.

name: arroway_remember
title: Propose a durable memory
